definitions.gloss: chain, chain reaction, series of linked events
definitions.explanation: A sequence of events or phenomena where each one causes or triggers the next, forming a connected chain.

examples.japanese: {悪循環|あくじゅんかん}の{連鎖|れんさ}を{断|た}ち{切|き}る。
examples.english: To break the chain of a vicious cycle.

examples.japanese: ひとつの{事故|じこ}が{連鎖|れんさ}{反応|はんのう}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こした。
examples.english: One accident triggered a chain reaction.

examples.japanese: {暴力|ぼうりょく}の{連鎖|れんさ}を{止|と}めるために、{対話|たいわ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Dialogue is needed to stop the chain of violence.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{連|れん} (connect, link) + {鎖|さ} (chain) = linked chain.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {連鎖|れんさ}{反応|はんのう}: chain reaction
- {連鎖|れんさ}{倒産|とうさん}: chain of bankruptcies (domino effect)
- {食物|しょくもつ}{連鎖|れんさ}: food chain
- {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}: negative chain, downward spiral

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連鎖|れんさ}を{断|た}ち{切|き}る: to break the chain
- {連鎖|れんさ}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす: to trigger a chain reaction
- {連鎖|れんさ}が{続|つづ}く: the chain continues

USAGE NOTE:
{連鎖|れんさ} often appears in contexts describing negative cascading effects ({負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}), but can also be neutral (as in {食物|しょくもつ}{連鎖|れんさ}, food chain).
